headline: Clinton order updates how federal agencies carry out the Enterprise for the Americas Initiative, a program for Latin America and the Caribbean.
what_it_does: This order changes an earlier 1991 executive order (Executive Order 12757) that set up how the government runs the Enterprise for the Americas Initiative. That initiative deals with US programs for countries in Latin America and the Caribbean, such as reducing debts owed to the US. No summary was provided, so the specific changes in this order are not clear from the title alone.

who_it_affects.group: Federal agencies that run the Enterprise for the Americas Initiative
who_it_affects.how: The order likely adjusts which agencies or officials handle certain duties under the program.

who_it_affects.group: Governments in Latin America and the Caribbean that take part in the initiative
who_it_affects.how: They may be affected by changes in how the US manages the program, though the details are not given.

when_it_takes_effect: Likely on signing, July 22, 1999 (not stated in the source material)
